description: This file defines the ErrorMessage class in the SuiteCRM project, providing a framework for handling error messages, logging, and exceptions with configurable levels and behaviors.

classes.name: ErrorMessage
classes.description: A class providing mechanisms for error handling, logging, and exception throwing within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the error message object with message, code, level, and throw behavior.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Set or update the state of the error message, including message, code, log level, and throw flag.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Performs logging and throws an exception based on current state settings.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Static method to create an ErrorMessage instance and handle it immediately.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Static method to log a message without throwing an exception.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Static method to log a message and throw an exception with a default code.
